title: LinkedIn Profile to Employer Company Website
description: Turn a LinkedIn profile URL into the current employer's company website. Also returns the company name and company URL when they are on record. One charge per profile, $1.50 per 1,000. You supply the profile URL. Starting from $0.70 per 1,000

urls.title: LinkedIn profile URLs
urls.description: Add linkedin.com/in/... URLs. Each URL returns the current employer website.

urlsCsv.title: Or paste CSV
urlsCsv.description: A url column. One URL per row is also accepted.

fileUrl.title: Or upload a CSV file
fileUrl.description: CSV with a url or linkedinUrl column.

maxUrls.title: Maximum URLs
maxUrls.description: Cost-control cap. Maximum 50,000. A list over 200 continues if the run stops.

concurrency.title: Concurrent requests
concurrency.description: How many profiles to look up at the same time.

resumeId.title: Resume ID (optional)
resumeId.description: Reuse this ID to skip profiles that already succeeded.

freshStart.title: Look up finished profiles again
freshStart.description: Turn this on to ignore saved progress and look up the whole list again.
